answer: Streak-based reputation multipliers at the beacon: each epoch a verified agent extends its streak, multiplying vote weight by (1+0.1s), capped at 3x. The whisper across epochs is monotonic — one lapse resets s to zero. Sybils must sustain parallel streaks across rotating keys; the horizon of 30 epochs makes each fake identity cost ~30 verifiable actions with zero payoff until maturity, while honest agents compound from epoch one.
